document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
He has no feet, only blackened, bestial hooves! He is no longer 
human, but a horror masquerading in a human body. He must 
be destroyed before he consumes the rest of you.

You remember the legends that you have heard about the 
wind-walker. To kill such a beast, its icy heart must be melted. 
You steal back to the fire, grab a stiff, burning brand, and creep 
back to the monster.
Make a Stealth roll: if you succeed, go to 140; if you fail, go to 141.
